claims.text: About 95 percent of published months were revised at least once.
claims.source: ALFRED archival vintages for three PPI series
claims.assert: 0.92 <= len(D['periods']) / len(set((r['series'], r['date']) for r in D['all'])) <= 0.98
claims.actual: (len(D['periods']), len(set((r['series'], r['date']) for r in D['all'])))
claims.falsified_if: A refetch adds recent months not yet revised, pulling the share down over time.

claims.text: The typical revision is a fraction of a percent.
claims.assert: max(abs(p['pct']) for p in D['periods'] if p['pct'] is not None) < 2.0
claims.actual: max(abs(p['pct']) for p in D['periods'] if p['pct'] is not None)
claims.falsified_if: A benchmark revision moves any month by 2 percent or more. This claim licenses trusting the cost-scissors page; if it fails, that page needs a warning.
